methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: NoVA Leaders Debate Data Centers, Metro Funding And Affordable Housing - Patch
signals.signal_reading: NoVA leaders debating data center policy infrastructure signals deepening AI-related economic concentration in the region, with decisions about metro funding and housing directly tied to data center tax revenue that other Virginia regions cannot access.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI creating 'pressure' on Richmond's young workforce without corresponding depth-building infrastructure suggests shallow adoption anxiety rather than capability development—workers feeling threatened rather than empowered by AI transformation.

signals.title: Virginia Tech gears up to fight enemy drones
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's $5M Army drone defense project in rural Kentland Farm represents deep technical capability distributed beyond NoVA corridors, potentially seeding specialized AI/autonomy expertise in New River Valley that could spread through regional networks.

signals.title: Virginia Beach schools bring ChatGPT under division oversight as AI use grows - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Beach schools bringing ChatGPT under division oversight signals platform-mediated AI adoption spreading to education sector—broad but shallow implementation focused on governance of commercial tools rather than building internal AI literacy or capability.

signals.title: Emerald AI reaches unicorn status with $1.05B valuation - Virginia Business
signals.signal_reading: Emerald AI achieving unicorn status with $1.05B valuation concentrates both AI capital formation and high-skill talent magnetism in NoVA, creating a self-reinforcing excellence cluster that widens the gap with regions lacking venture ecosystem density.
